## Covers, hearts, your own background
- **Spotify covers fixed:** songs that showed an empty cover or the playlist's cover (for example under Recently played or in playlists read without a Spotify sign-in) now get their real album cover. The server looks it up once from Spotify's public pages, like the Msik bot, keeps it for every device and repairs imported playlists. YouTube songs always show their video picture
- **Open the download folder:** Settings → Offline has a folder button next to "On this device". On the PC it opens Explorer / the file manager, on Android the Files app (under "Streyn")
- **Heart in every song row:** next to the + there is now always a heart that puts the song straight into your liked songs, also for songs from Spotify & co., on the phone too
- **Streyn logo = Home:** the logo at the top left (title bar, side bar, phone header) takes you home
- **Your own background:** Settings → General → Background: your own picture or one of ten ready-made ones (Aurora, Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Ember, Starry night, Graphite and three with the Streyn logo), with sliders for opacity and blur. Works with every theme
- **Liquid Glass sliders:** the coloured line of progress, volume and every slider in the settings now ends just before the glass knob, also while dragging
- **Liquid Glass corners:** the "Connect to a device" dialog and the queue panel in the big player are round on every corner again (no square glass sticking out)
- **Round cover with the ring visualizer:** in the big player the cover is always a circle with the ring visualizer, in every theme
- Docs updated (Background, folder button)

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Windows / Linux:** update the desktop app (1.28.0) for the folder button
- **Android:** install the new APK for the folder button; everything else comes from the server
